newsFlag.summary: Keenan Allen faces a minimum 3-game suspension due to his drunk-driving arrest and formal charges of two misdemeanors, making him unavailable for upcoming games.
Tim Patrick was placed on injured reserve due to a lingering groin injury and will be eligible to return after four games.
Perine missed practice Thursday and Friday with an illness but has no injury designation for Sunday's game, indicating he is expected to play.
Watson is confirmed as the Browns' starter for Week 2 after returning from injury, though his job security may be at risk pending evaluation of the QB situation.
Mack Hollins is active and healthy, but may see increased targets in Week 2 due to A.J. Brown's ankle injury.
Godwin was active and played extensively against Cincinnati, but concerns about his explosiveness and durability remain given his age and injury history.
Eddy Pineiro is dealing with an illness but is expected to be active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
DJ Moore sustained an AC joint shoulder sprain in Thursday's game and is uncertain for Week 3, though the injury is not considered serious and he has over a week to recover.
Sam Darnold is out for Sunday's game against Arizona due to a glute injury with an estimated four-week recovery timeline.
Meyers was limited in practice with a thumb injury but received no injury designation for Week 2, having successfully played through the same injury in Week 1.
Ashton Dulin is out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs with an ankle injury and has been labeled week-to-week by head coach Shane Steichen.
D.J. Montgomery was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to an abdominal injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Kyler Murray is out for Week 2 against Chicago due to a concussion but is expected to clear the protocol and return the following week against Tampa Bay.
David Sills was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least four weeks, with the earliest return date being Week 5.
Ty Johnson is inactive due to a hamstring injury that has persisted since late August, with Ray Davis taking over his backfield role.
Brown was active but inexplicably did not play in Week 1; reason unclear but expected to make regular-season debut in Week 2.
A.J. Brown was placed on injured reserve with a right high-ankle sprain sustained against the Seahawks and is expected to miss approximately six weeks.
Tua Tagovailoa is doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a strained oblique sustained on Sept. 10 and has not been able to practice.
Michael Pittman Jr. has been ruled out for Week 2 against the Patriots due to a foot injury after limited practice participation Wednesday and missing drills Thursday and Friday.
Jauan Jennings is ruled out for Week 2 against Chicago due to a personal matter (not injury-related) and is expected to return for Week 3 against Tampa Bay.
Joe Burrow was limited early in the week with a back injury but progressed to full participation by Friday and is expected to start Sunday's game against the Texans.
Nico Collins is ruled out for Week 2 against the Bengals with a hamstring injury and may miss Week 3 as well, though it's not considered long-term.
Nwangwu (back) is ruled out for Week 2 against the Packers and is considered week-to-week, missing consecutive games.
Elijah Moore is inactive for Sunday's game against the Commanders due to coach's decision, as he is the fourth option behind Smith, Wicks, and Brown at wide receiver.
Jake Tonges suffered an MCL tear in the season opener and requires surgery, ending his season on injured reserve.
Chris Olave is dealing with a hamstring injury but is expected to play Sunday against the Ravens after making the trip to Baltimore with his team.
Ogletree was limited by a neck injury Wednesday but progressed to full practice participation Thursday and is trending toward playing Sunday against Baltimore.
Jordan Mason has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Malik Davis underwent hip surgery and was placed on injured reserve, sidelining him for the entire 2026 season.
Pierce was a full participant in practice Friday after a maintenance day Thursday and carries no injury designation for Sunday's game.
Tolbert is inactive for Sunday's game against the Raiders due to coach's decision and will be benched in favor of younger receivers.
Chig Okonkwo has been ruled out for Week 2 against Dallas due to a hamstring injury and did not practice all week.
Davis sustained an undisclosed injury in Week 1 but was a full participant in Wednesday's practice and is on track to play Sunday against the Raiders.
Aidan O'Connell has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers due to a personal matter.
Whyle suffered a neck injury in Week 1 but was cleared from the injury report and is on track to play Week 2, though he remains a backup behind Kraft and Smith.
Boutte is active and expected to see increased playing time with Nico Collins ruled out due to hamstring injury, though he remains a low-volume option in the Texans' passing game.
Blake Grupe is inactive for Week 1 due to coach's decision, with the Jets elevating Jason Sanders instead, and his Week 2 availability uncertain pending Sanders' performance.
Tucker was a full participant in Wednesday's practice after missing Week 1 with a hamstring injury, but faces competition from Bucky Irving for carries.
Marvin Mims Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars due to a foot injury.
Zay Flowers was downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Saints due to a left hamstring injury he aggravated in Week 1.
Mayer is active and produced as the fill-in at tight end with Bowers sidelined, but his role could diminish if Bowers returns next week.
Davis Allen was evaluated for a concussion in Week 1 but was cleared to return and is expected to practice and play in Week 2.
Puka Nacua is questionable for Monday's game against the Giants due to a hip/groin injury and missed practice Friday and Saturday, with his status to be determined as a pre-game decision.

Zach Charbonnet (torn left ACL) remains on reserve/PUP and won't be eligible to practice until Week 5 prep, with his return window opening sometime after that if cleared by the Seahawks coaching staff.
Nabers returned from ACL/meniscus tear suffered last season and played in Week 1, catching 6 of 9 targets for 69 yards, though he was listed as questionable entering the game.

Brock Bowers is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Chargers due to a knee injury, with a pregame workout to determine his playing status, though the Raiders are optimistic about his return for Week 3.
Brooks played in Week 1 after missing practice due to groin injury and soreness but received no game designation, though he saw limited touches behind Chuba Hubbard.
Jalen Coker rolled his ankle in Week 1 but participated fully in Friday's practice with no game designation for Sunday's matchup against Atlanta.
Jordan Whittington is doubtful for Monday's game against the Giants due to a quadriceps injury sustained in Week 1 and has not practiced since the injury.
Walker missed Week 1 with a groin injury but is now active and expected to have a significant role in Sunday's game against the Saints with Zay Flowers doubtful.
Erick All is active and saw offensive snaps in Sunday's game but is operating as the third tight end with limited offensive opportunity.

McMillan is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns due to a knee issue he's been dealing with since early August, with his availability status uncertain until 90 minutes before kickoff.
Thomas has no injury designation for Sunday's game despite being listed as a limited practice participant all week due to a shoulder injury, though there remains some re-injury risk.
McConkey (ribs) has made rapid progress and intends to play Sunday against the Raiders, but a final decision will be made closer to game time after limited Friday practice.
Michael Penix Jr. is ruled Out for Week 1 against the Panthers due to a knee injury from his ACL tear last November, with a possible return in Week 3 against Green Bay.
Wester is active and preparing for an expanded role due to Zay Flowers' questionable hamstring injury status.
Jimmy Holiday was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Dylan Sampson was placed on injured reserve with a knee injury and will miss at least the next four games, though he is expected back this season.
Jaylin Lane was limited in practice with a groin issue but has no official injury designation and is expected to play his usual special teams role against Dallas.
DJ Giddens is questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs due to a knee injury, and even if active, may see limited action or be kept inactive despite full practice participation on Friday.
KeAndre Lambert-Smith was placed on injured reserve with a significant hamstring injury suffered in Week 1 and will miss at least four games, eligible to return Week 6.
LeQuint Allen Jr. has no injury designation for Sunday's game against Denver after missing training camp and preseason with a hip injury, and is expected to see an increased role.
Caleb Lohner was placed on injured reserve with a lower-body injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Raheim Sanders is active and will see an expanded role as the Browns' RB2 after Dylan Sampson was placed on injured reserve.
Tory Horton was a full practice participant Wednesday after missing Week 1 with a hamstring injury and is expected to play Sunday against the Cardinals.
Dillon Gabriel has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
RJ Harvey is unlikely to play Sunday against the Jaguars due to a hamstring injury despite limited practice participation Thursday and Friday.
Henderson is cleared to play Sunday against the Steelers after missing Week 1 with an ankle injury and practicing without limitations this week.
Carson Towt has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Ja'Kobi Lane underwent wrist surgery and was placed on injured reserve, requiring him to miss at least four games with his next opportunity for action on Oct. 18.
Nicholas Singleton is inactive for Week 1 due to coach's decision as a healthy scratch behind three other running backs on the depth chart.
Cole Payton is inactive for Sunday's game against the Commanders due to coach's decision as the fourth-string quarterback on the roster.
Fagnano is inactive for Sunday's game against the Colts due to coach's decision, as he is third on the depth chart behind Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley.
Jeremiyah Love returned to action after managing a high-ankle sprain and appeared at full health, though his workload may have been limited due to cautionary usage and lack of summer practice time.
De'Zhaun Stribling was placed on injured reserve after suffering a left ankle deltoid sprain that requires surgery and an expected 10-week recovery period.
Oscar Delp cleared to play against the Ravens in Week 2 after missing Week 1 with a hamstring injury, though his snap count may be limited.
Kaelon Black is dealing with a groin injury and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, though he is expected to play pending confirmation before kickoff.
Joly is inactive for Sunday's game against the Raiders due to coach's decision as the fourth-string tight end option.
Taylen Green is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jaguars as the emergency third-string quarterback behind Deshaun Watson and Shedeur Sanders.
Claiborne was a healthy scratch in Week 1 but is expected to see increased playing time at backup running back with Jordan Mason sidelined on injured reserve.
Jack Endries is inactive for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers due to coach's decision, as he is buried on the depth chart behind multiple tight ends.
Skyler Bell is inactive for Thursday's game versus Detroit due to coach's decision after being a healthy scratch the previous week, with his next opportunity in Week 3.
Eli Stowers was placed on injured reserve with quadriceps and hamstring injuries and will miss at least the first four games of the season.
Omar Cooper Jr. has been placed on injured reserve due to a sprained ankle suffered in his pro debut and will miss at least the next four games.
Chris Bell is active and playing after tearing his ACL last December, with snap count expected to increase as conditioning improves.
